summary: Aptevo Therapeutics filed an 8-K solely to announce clinical data from a press release: a 93% clinical benefit rate and 79% CR/CRi in 14 evaluable frontline TP53-mutated AML patients treated with mipletamig plus venetoclax and azacitidine. No financial or structural deal terms, no transaction, no corporate action. This is routine operational news for a clinical-stage biotech, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other event-type item. Watch for future regulatory or financing disclosures, but no risk-arb angle exists.
